timers.name: Sentinel
timers.does: Checks the other services and opens an ask after two failures in a row.

timers.name: PR collector
timers.does: Reads open and merged pull requests of every project into prs.json (read-only).

timers.name: Lab runner
timers.does: Moves Lab ideas one step along the chain.

timers.name: Nightly backup
timers.does: Backs up the notes and the data files to object storage.

timers.name: Thermostat sync
timers.does: Pushes the heating schedule to the thermostat.

routines.name: Morning digest
routines.does: One morning message: what broke, what shipped, what waits for you.

routines.name: Docs link check
routines.does: Checks the links in the docs and opens an ask for broken ones.

routines.name: Weekly review
routines.does: Writes what moved this week per project and what stalled.

routines.name: Dependency audit
routines.does: Lists outdated and vulnerable dependencies; opens an ask, never a PR.
routines.note: Last week it hit the API rate limit once.

routines.name: Benchmark re-run
routines.does: Re-runs the benchmark after the grader fix.

routines.name: Incident write-up
routines.does: Drafts an incident note from the journal when asked.
